# MarinAI

> MarinAI is the independent marketing consultancy of Marina Katz-Goldenberg, a marketing and AI consultant running a Portugal-registered business and working remotely. MarinAI helps businesses with marketing strategy, practical AI adoption, search visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO), AI marketing workflows, team enablement, and full-service influencer launches on X (Twitter).

Contact: marketing@marinai.xyz. No payments are taken through the website; scope and fees are agreed before work starts.

## Services

- [X influencer launch](https://marinai.xyz/x-influencer-launch/): For companies that want a big launch on X but don't know where to start. MarinAI handles everything, like an influencer agency: finding and vetting influencers, writing their briefs, handling contracts and payments, finding the key messages, writing the launch video script, creating the video, and reporting and analysis after launch. Influencer fees usually run from $5,000 to $30,000 per launch. Visitors tick what they need on a checklist, then book a call; the quote comes after the call. Every paid post is disclosed.
- [Marketing strategy & AI adoption](https://marinai.xyz/ai-marketing-strategy/): Readiness audit, prioritised AI use cases and a practical marketing roadmap.
- [AI search visibility: SEO, GEO & AEO](https://marinai.xyz/ai-search-visibility/): Making a business easier to discover, understand and reference in search results and AI-generated answers.
- [AI marketing workflows & automation](https://marinai.xyz/marketing-ai-workflows/): Workflow mapping, tool evaluation and focused pilots with human review.
- [Marketing AI advisory & team enablement](https://marinai.xyz/marketing-ai-advisory/): Role-specific working sessions and ongoing strategic guidance.
